svg.title: A terminal, and what it has been typing
svg.desc: 👋🏻 Hello World! / 📖 Guides nobody can ignore / 📊 Runs you can rerun later / 🔗 No action without an SBOM / ⏱️ Feedback in under a minute / 🧮 Cost measured, not assumed / 🔔 Alert only when it is real / ⛓️ A rule that cannot rot quietly / 🧪 Linters that earn their runtime / 🪵 Every request in one place / 📉 One fewer decision to maintain / ✂️ Deleting more than I write / 📐 One way in with no exceptions
